phrases.latin: nam tunc sūgere nōram et adquiēscere dēlectātiōnibus, flēre autem offēnsiōnēs carnis meae, nihil amplius
phrases.english: for then I knew how to suck, and to settle when I was content, and to cry when my body was hurt; nothing more
